channel.title: Coursebook Informatics
channel.description: Welcome to the Maker Journey: in one school year (2 lessons per week) you will complete five projects covering all competencies of the Informatics curriculum for grades 9–11. The five projects Code & Gadget – Python basics and your first interactive device Weather Station / IoT – sensors, networks and data AI Lab – from decision trees to generative AI Data Detectives – SQL, encryption, privacy Web Portfolio – your own project website, developed with agile methods Along the way you keep a learning journal and work in teams using Kanban and sprints.

item.title: Projects
item.description: The five projects of the Maker Journey. Every project follows the same rhythm: Kickoff & requirements → sprints (build) → review & presentation → retrospective + journal submission

item.title: Self-Study
item.description: Learning paths for independent study: curated links and videos, with one journal task and one quiz per path.

item.title: Tools
item.description: Setup guides for all course tools — for school PCs and your own devices (BYOD). Browser tools work everywhere.

item.title: Teachers
item.description: Materials for teachers: competency matrix (curriculum traceability), weekly schedule and rubric templates.
